reports.title: Applied Industrial Technologies Reports Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Guidance
section: Today, the Company is modestly increasing fiscal 2027 EPS guidance to a range of $11.70 to $12.20 (prior $11.65 to $12.15) to reflect a slightly lower diluted share count assumption following first quarter share repurchases. The Company is maintaining guidance for sales of up 4.0% to 6.5%, as well as EBITDA margins of 12.5% to 12.8%. Guidance continues to incorporate macro uncertainty tied to ongoing geopolitical events and trade policy dynamics, as well as broader inflationary headwinds and growth investments. Guidance does not assume contribution from future acquisitions or share buybacks.
